_comment: Per docs/decisions/002-sp5-cost-model.md's Decision: 'The per-unit constants table above ships as a versioned config, not hardcoded, specifically so it can be overwritten by real measurements once they exist.' Every number here is a first-pass assumption, not a calibrated one -- unverified until real run_manifest.json cost data accumulates (see that record's Consequences / recalibration protocol).

pricing._comment: Sonnet 5, per token, from platform.claude.com/docs as of 2026-08-25.

derived_ratios._comment: D (DTOs) ~= P (surface points) * this ratio -- some points need more than one DTO (e.g. SDK call site + collector config). Midpoint of SP5's stated 1.2-2x range.
